fields.headline: Ship Stability Simulator — GZ Curve
fields.lead: A free online ship stability simulator: enter breadth, depth, deadrise, bilge radius, draught and KG to get the equilibrium waterline, the GZ righting-arm curve, GM, maximum GZ, angle of vanishing stability and areas under the curve.

fields.content:
Features

  • GZ curve by heel angle, 2D section with K, G, B, M and a 3D model as the vessel heels.
  • Basic IS Code 2008 criteria: areas 0–30°, 0–40°, 30–40°, GZ at 30°, angle of GZmax, initial GM.
  • Roll simulation and several loading conditions on one chart.
  • Word and Excel reports; Vietnamese and English interface.

Who it is for

Naval architects, students and owners who need a quick check of transverse stability at the preliminary stage. Results are indicative; approval documents need a full stability calculation — see our ship design services.

fields.heading: Need a full calculation for approval?
fields.description: Simulation results are indicative at the preliminary stage. Send us the vessel particulars and we will prepare the calculations and documents for approval.
